tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for agreeing to participate. I'd like to ask you some questions about your personal finance habits. First, how often do you review your money management, such as tracking your expenses or budgeting? Do you do this weekly, monthly, or less often?
tasks.sample: I usually review my personal finances on a monthly basis. At the end of each month, I go through my spending and check where my money goes. I don’t do it weekly because my daily expenses are pretty stable, and checking too often feels time‑consuming. Sometimes I also do a quick check every few weeks if I spend more than usual. Monthly budgeting works best for me to stay on track with my money.
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你同意参与本次调研。我想问你几个关于个人理财习惯的问题。首先，你多久复盘一次自己的资金管理情况，比如记录开销、做预算？是每周、每月，还是频率更低？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you. Can you describe one or two methods you or someone you know uses to manage your finances? For example, do you use budgeting apps or keep a written record?
tasks.sample: Well, I mainly use a simple budgeting app to track my daily expenses. It automatically records my spending and sorts them into categories like food, transport and shopping. Besides, my roommate keeps a handwritten notebook to log every purchase. Writing things down helps her avoid overspending. Both ways are easy and practical for regular money management.
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢。你能说说你本人或你认识的人使用的一两种理财方式吗？例如，你会使用记账软件，还是手写记账？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Tell me about a financial goal you have achieved recently.What motivated you to achieve this goal?
tasks.sample: I totally agree that financial education should be mandatory in schools. Most teenagers know little about budgeting or saving money. Without proper guidance, they may overspend or get into debt as adults. Schools can teach basic money skills like budgeting and avoiding bad loans. These lessons are extremely useful in real life, much more practical than some textbook knowledge.
tasks.analysis: 中文：很有意思。和我讲讲你最近达成的一个理财目标吧。是什么激励你实现了这个目标？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great. Some people believe that fiscal responsibility education should be mandatory in schools to help students manage money effectively as adults. Do you agree or disagree with this idea?Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好。有些人认为，理财责任教育应当在学校列为必修课，帮助学生成年后高效管理钱财。你是否认同这一观点？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
